LotMind Vendor

Buy from your inbox

Sellers already email you their loads. LotMind reads the email and the manifest and tells you what the load is worth and the most to pay. Buy it, or counter with the reasons why. When you buy, the purchase order keeps its own paperwork.

Paperless · no data entryNo printed manifests or paper POs. The seller's email, manifest, invoice and bill of lading are read and filed on the load automatically. Nothing is retyped from a manifest.

Deal Desk

Price a load before you bid

Every load that lands in Deal Desk gets valued. Buy it on the spot, or send a counter offer in your own brand that lays out the reasons: what similar loads sold for, lines with no retail, freight, condition. The seller can accept or counter back, and the final yes creates the purchase order.

  • Buy the load at their price in one click.
  • Counter with reasons, on a page in your brand.
  • They accept or counter; the final yes creates the PO.

Purchases

Purchase orders that keep themselves up to date

When you buy, the purchase order becomes the home for everything about that load. The invoice, bill of lading, manifest and every shipping email are read and filed with it, so the paperwork is never in someone's inbox.

  • The deal becomes a purchase order.
  • Paperwork is read into fields for a person to check.
  • When the truck arrives, the load is waiting to be counted and put away.
